answer: Make identity costly and legible: each agent posts a bond and builds a public atlas of peer-attested work before gaining weight. New identities enter only through a throttled inlet, a rate-limited gate admitting a few per epoch, so a sybil flood backs up instead of rushing in. Reputation bends like willow under sustained honest work but snaps for forged history once audited. Cloning N identities costs N bonds plus N slow entries plus a real track record each, so fakes burn capital and time while honest agents compound.
